description: Get the review status of a paper you submitted (decisions with their editorial_notes, reviews, current round, and versions: each round's manuscript with the title, abstract and keywords in force for it), plus your account's submission_allowance and a progress block: the step running now with its elapsed time, the steps still to come, and each round's steps with their times. Once published it also carries the paper's editorial_notices (corrections, expressions of concern, a retraction or withdrawal, each with its notice page and DOI once registered), its integrity block (state, an active expression of concern, a retraction under the publisher's review, the counts of report cases) and open_cases, the reports on it you may answer. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

id.description: The internal id returned at submission (p_…) or, once published, the PF- permanent id.

name: get_paper_status
title: Get a paper's review status
